title: The new app icon — eyes and outline

steps.path: The Start menu, desktop shortcut, taskbar, Dock and app list, once YouCoded is installed
steps.headline: Which eyes should the waving sticker mascot have?
steps.notice: All four are the waving sticker mascot, now a little smaller inside the tile, with a white outline. Every eye comes from the app's own mascot face kit, so it matches the mascot inside YouCoded.
steps.risk: The mascot rules forbid pale or white eyes on a coloured body, because they read as glowing holes, so none of these lighten the eye itself; they lighten what is in it or around it.

variants.label: Round 3 eyes
variants.summary: What you saw last round, for comparison: dark eyes with small purple sparkles.

variants.label: White sparkles
variants.summary: The same dark eyes with three bright white sparkles, so they look lit up.

variants.label: Softer, big shine
variants.summary: A softer, lighter purple-brown eye with one big white shine and one small one. Rounder and cuter; the look the cat mascots use.
variants.risk: The softer eye has less contrast against the purple body at the smallest sizes.

variants.label: Light ring
variants.summary: Dark eyes with a thin lavender ring around each and the big white shine, so the eyes stand out from the body.
variants.risk: The ring can blur into the body below the biggest size.

steps.path: The Start menu, desktop shortcut, taskbar, Dock and app list, once YouCoded is installed
steps.headline: Which outline colour should the sticker mascot have?
steps.notice: All four use the white-sparkle eyes; the eyes you pick above apply to any of them.
steps.risk: The sticker style's own rule keeps the outline white in every theme. A different colour here changes only the app icon, not the mascot inside themes.

variants.label: White
variants.summary: The sticker style as designed: a crisp white die-cut edge.
variants.risk: On the lavender tile the white edge is soft; it pops more on dark backgrounds.

variants.label: Pale lavender
variants.summary: An off-white with a hint of lavender, so the edge sits into the tile instead of glowing.
variants.risk: The quietest of the four; the sticker look nearly disappears on the tile.

variants.label: Lilac
variants.summary: A mid lilac between the tile and the body: a soft, clearly visible edge.

variants.label: Deep purple
variants.summary: A dark purple edge, like an ink line. The strongest outline and the easiest to read at small sizes.
variants.risk: Reads more like a cartoon ink line than a sticker.
